study_title: Requirements Classification Evidence Triage on a Gold-Standard Benchmark
design: Secondary benchmark evaluation with oracle and prediction-only human-review routing
source_name: eTour fine-grained requirements-classification benchmark in the FTLR replication package
upstream_code_license_note: The FTLR source repository is GPL-3.0. This repository does not copy upstream source code; it computes and packages derived evaluation evidence and metrics.
integrity_policy: The source rebuild uses exact commit-pinned URLs, prints SHA-256 hashes for both fetched CSV files, and checks the complete 571-row derived evidence plus all packaged primary and triage results.
claim_boundary: The 51.9% top-100 figure is an oracle upper bound because it uses gold-label errors for ranking. The deployable prediction-pattern-rarity heuristic uses automatic predictions only, is exploratory and post hoc, and is not externally validated.
